_about: One-line summaries of each N5 rule, written in our own words for quick reference at the table. They are not the rules: each entry in the catalogue also links to the full official text on the Infinity wiki, and the wiki wins wherever the two differ. Keys must match the rule names in tools/wiki/n5_data.json.
Alert: If the trooper or an ally in its ZoC is attacked and it hasn't acted that Order, it may turn to face any direction at the end of the Order. No roll, no AROs.
BS Attack: Shoot with a ranged weapon, skill or equipment using BS (or whichever attribute the weapon names). LoF is needed unless the weapon says otherwise, and Burst can be split between targets.
Cautious Movement: Move up to your first MOV value without drawing AROs, provided you start and finish outside every enemy's LoF and ZoC, and outside enemy hacking areas if you're Hackable.
CC Attack: Fight an enemy in base contact with a CC-trait weapon, rolling CC. Each success forces a saving roll.
Climb: Move up or across a vertical surface, up to your first MOV value plus 2 inches. No roll.
Discover: Reveal an enemy marker by passing a WIP roll modified as if you were shooting it. A trooper that fails can't try the same marker again that turn.
Dodge: Roll PH, face to face against the attacker, to avoid every attack in the Order (not comms attacks). Success lets you move up to 2 inches.
Idle: Do nothing. It still counts as activating, so it can draw AROs, and it's what happens when a declared skill turns out to be illegal.
Intuitive Attack: With an Intuitive Attack weapon, pass an unmodified WIP roll to take a single shot at a target you can't see because of zero visibility or a marker state.
Jump: Leap in any direction, including an arc, up to your first MOV value plus 2 inches, landing somewhere at least as big as your base. No roll.
Move: Move up to your first MOV value. Declaring Move again in the same Order adds the second value.
Look Out: An ARO for a trooper that sees an enemy act: every other trooper on your side may turn to face, by passing a Dodge roll at PH-3.
Place Deployable: Put a deployable weapon, piece of equipment or ancillary peripheral on the table in base contact, or anywhere along your path in the Active Turn. No roll.
Reload: While in the ZoC of an ally carrying Baggage, clear your Unloaded state or restore every spent use of your Disposable kit. One trooper per Order.
Request Speedball: Spend two Speedball tokens to drop two supply pods onto the table using the Combat Jump procedure (PH 15). Each pod carries a Speedball Chart item: one chosen, one rolled.
Reset: Roll WIP, face to face against the attacker's WIP, to shrug off every comms attack and Guided attack in the Order.
Speculative Attack: With a Speculative Attack weapon, lob a single shot at a target out of LoF along a possible trajectory. A circular template can land off-centre as long as it still covers the target.
Suppressive Fire: Pick a weapon with the Suppressive Fire trait and enter the Suppressive Fire state with it.
Aerial: The trooper is airborne. It can't go Prone or be Engaged, never counts as touching models, objectives or scenery, can't use Cautious Movement, and doesn't set off Boost weapons.
Berserk: One Long Skill: charge up to both MOV values combined into base contact with a target in LoF, then attack in close combat, adding any bonus in brackets. If the charge can't reach, the trooper Idles.
Booty: When the trooper is placed on the table, roll on the Booty Chart for a bonus item on top of its normal gear.
Camouflage: The trooper can deploy as a Camouflage marker, and can go back into the Camouflaged state during the game.
Chain of Command: If your Lieutenant is Isolated or in a Null state when Loss of Lieutenant is checked, this trooper takes over as Lieutenant on the spot and the check counts as passed.
Climbing Plus: Climb becomes a Short Skill when it's the first one declared in an Order, and Move or Dodge can carry the trooper up and across walls as if they were floors.
Combat Instinct: Enemy Surprise Attack penalties don't apply to this trooper.
Combat Jump: Airborne Deployment: the trooper waits off the table, then on its own Order is placed on any open horizontal surface and rolls PH. On a pass it lands there; on a fail it arrives at its own table edge as a model.
Commlink: Lets the army keep a Reinforcements Section and call it in with Request Reinforcements, even after the Commlink trooper falls. A bracketed bonus raises the army's trooper limit. One per army.
Courage: The trooper may pass any Guts roll automatically and ignores Retreat!, though Loss of Lieutenant still affects it.
Counterintelligence: Blunts the enemy's strategic use of Command Tokens: they cancel only one of your Orders, or your Command Token allowance rises to two.
Cyberplug: The trooper can take Cyberplug Peripherals.
Decoy: The trooper can deploy in the Decoy state.
Doctor: In base contact with an Unconscious trooper that has VITA, pass a WIP roll to heal one wound and bring it round. A failed roll kills the patient.
Dogged: When it falls Unconscious, the trooper can keep fighting as if unhurt for the rest of that Player Turn, then dies in the States Phase. Any further wound kills it at once, and it can't be healed.
Engineer: In base contact with a target that has STR, pass a WIP roll to repair one wound, repeating as often as needed. A failed roll adds a wound instead.
Explode: When knocked Unconscious, the trooper detonates at the end of the Order: a circular template centred on it, Shock ammunition at PS 7. Then it's removed as Dead.
Forward Deployment: The trooper can deploy up to the bracketed distance beyond your Deployment Zone.
Forward Observer: A ranged attack rolled with WIP that leaves its target Targeted instead of forcing a saving roll.
Frenzy: Once the trooper wounds or kills an enemy, it gains Impetuous and Limited Cover for the rest of the game, and drops out of any marker state.
FT Master: While the trooper is in a Fireteam, every member counts as Regular. If they already were, the Team Leader's coherency range grows by 2 inches.
G: Jumper: The trooper fields two or three Proxy bodies that share one Order and count as one trooper. Only the active Proxy acts, and control can jump to another Proxy when one goes down.
Guard: The trooper can make CC Attacks against an enemy in its LoF and ZoC without reaching base contact, and both sides use their contact-based close combat skills as normal.
Hacker: The trooper can carry a Hacking Device and run the programs it grants, run some programs without one, and take Upgrade Programs. Works even while the trooper is in a Null state.
Hidden Deployment: The trooper can deploy in the Hidden Deployment state, with its position kept secret.
Immunity: The trooper ignores the special effects of whatever is in brackets, such as an ammunition type or a trait, treating that ammunition as Normal. Wider versions cover every ARM-based or BTS-based attack.
Impersonation: Deploy disguised as an Impersonation marker anywhere outside the enemy Deployment Zone, or inside it by passing a WIP roll. A failed roll puts the trooper at its own table edge as a model.
Impetuous: The trooper gets a free activation in the Impetuous Phase, limited to a set menu of actions and forced to rush the nearest enemy or the enemy Deployment Zone.
Infiltration: Deploy anywhere in your own half, or in the enemy half (outside their Deployment Zone) by passing a PH-3 roll. A failed roll puts the trooper at its own table edge as a model.
Infinity Spec-Ops: A customisable trooper: at list building, add two options from the Spec-Ops Chart. In play it can switch to its Enhanced Profile by collecting a SpecBall. One per army.
Inspiring Leadership: Improves Fireteam coherency. While its owner is the Lieutenant and on the table, every Order-giving trooper is Regular with Courage, Coordinated Orders cost only the Lieutenant Order, and the army ignores Retreat!.
Journalist: Allies in the trooper's ZoC get +3 to Guts rolls. Enemies in its ZoC get -3.
Lieutenant: The army's commander, with a Special Lieutenant Order. If it is Isolated, in a Null state or off the table at the Tactical Phase, Loss of Lieutenant applies. Some profiles add extras such as +1 Command Token or +1 Order.
Limited Cover: Attacks against this trooper ignore the -3 penalty for Partial Cover.
Marksmanship: When the trooper makes a BS Attack, it ignores the penalties from Partial Cover and Nanoscreen.
Martial Arts: Gives the close combat bonuses for the level listed on the profile, as set out in the Martial Arts Chart.
MetaChemistry: When the trooper is placed on the table, roll once on the MetaChemistry Table for a bonus MOD or extra skill.
Mimetism: Enemies shooting at the trooper with LoF, or trying to Discover it, take the bracketed penalty, such as -3 or -6. It doesn't apply in close combat.
Minelayer: When the trooper deploys, it can also place a deployable weapon or piece of equipment (or the bracketed number of them) in its ZoC, provided no enemy or camouflage marker is in the trigger area.
Mnemonica: When the trooper enters a Null state, its WIP, this skill and any Lieutenant role pass to an ally on the table that has a Cube or is a Remote. The original is then removed as Dead.
Morpho-Scan: No roll needed: the trooper copies the MOV, CC, BS and PH of an enemy with VITA in its ZoC. It counts as a Comms Attack, and a target that tries to Reset takes -9.
Natural Born Warrior: When the trooper is attacked in close combat and fights back, it ignores all the negative MODs its opponent would impose.
NCO: The trooper can turn Special Lieutenant Orders into Tactical Orders and use them, from any Combat Group. As a Fireteam leader, it can activate the team with them.
Neurocinetics: In its Active Turn, all the trooper's ranged weapons fire at Burst 1. In the Reactive Turn, it can fire its full Burst at a single target.
No Cover: The trooper never benefits from Partial Cover.
No Wound Incapacitation: When it falls Unconscious, the trooper carries on as if unhurt. One more wound kills it, though it can still be healed back to normal.
Non-Hackable: Hacking programs that target specific troop types (HI, REM, TAG and so on) can't target this trooper, even while it is in a Null state.
Number 2: If the Fireteam Leader is Isolated or in a Null state, this trooper can take over as leader immediately.
Parachutist: Airborne Deployment: the trooper waits off the table, then on its own Order enters at any table edge outside the enemy Deployment Zone, with no Partial Cover that Order. The (Deployment Zone) version can also enter inside it.
Paramedic: The trooper carries a MediKit for reviving Unconscious allies.
Peripheral: Covers a Controller and its Peripherals (secondary models): they count as one trooper, deploy together and act on the same Order, though each can pick its own target.
Protheion: In close combat, each wound the trooper inflicts on a target with VITA heals one of its own. If it's unhurt, its VITA rises instead, up to a limit.
Regeneration: In the States Phase, roll PH. A pass heals one wound and can end Unconscious; a fail adds one.
Religious Troop: The trooper passes Guts rolls automatically and holds its ground, though it may roll WIP to fall back as if it had failed. It ignores Retreat!, but Loss of Lieutenant still applies.
Remdriver: On deployment, tag one Remote already on the table. That Remote gains the bonuses listed on this trooper's profile until this trooper enters a Null state.
Remote Presence: A trooper with STR gets two levels of Unconscious, so it dies one wound later than usual. A single Engineer or GizmoKit success clears all the wounds keeping it down.
Request Reinforcements: With a Commlink trooper, keep a Reinforcement Section off the table and bring it in after taking casualties or in the final round, through an extra Request Reinforcements step in the turn.
Sapper: The trooper can deploy in the Foxhole state, or dig into it later as a Long Skill, as long as there's room for its template.
Sensor: A WIP+6 roll that reveals every hidden or camouflaged enemy in the trooper's ZoC at once, without needing LoF. Enemies can't re-camouflage there, and Discover rolls against camouflage markers get +6.
Sixth Sense: The trooper can react to attacks from outside its LoF as if it saw all around, ignores the -6 for shooting through zero visibility, and takes no penalties to Dodge or Reset except those from Immobilized and Isolated.
Specialist Operative: The trooper counts as a Specialist for mission and scenario rules.
Stealth: In its Active Turn, the trooper can use Cautious Movement inside enemy ZoC and hacking areas, and its movement only draws AROs from enemies who can see it.
Strategic Deployment: As a Fireteam's leader, the trooper deploys first and brings the whole team forward as if it had Forward Deployment (+4 inches).
Strategos: As Lieutenant, hold back two troopers to deploy after your opponent instead of one, and convert Special Lieutenant Orders into Regular Orders.
Super-Jump: Jump becomes a Short Skill when declared first in an Order, so the trooper can jump and shoot in one Order. A Jump taken as a Long Skill covers the first MOV value plus 4 inches. No Partial Cover while jumping.
Surprise Attack: Attacking from marker form or Hidden Deployment in its Active Turn, the trooper imposes the bracketed penalty on its targets. It must return to marker form before it can do so again.
Tactical Awareness: The trooper generates an extra Tactical Order, for its own use only, on top of its usual Order.
TAGCom: While on the table and not in a Null state, the trooper gives every TAG in its Combat Group the bonuses listed on its profile.
Tech-Recovery: When hit by an allied GizmoKit, pass a PH roll to clear every state an Engineer could fix, such as Immobilized or Isolated. It doesn't cover Unconscious.
Technorganic: Doctor, Engineer, MediKit or GizmoKit can each revive this trooper from Unconscious, whatever its wound attribute.
Terrain: In terrain of the listed type, the trooper gets +1 inch on its first MOV value and ignores that terrain's movement restrictions.
Total Reaction: The trooper can shoot AROs with its weapon's full Burst.
Transmutation: The trooper has a second profile and switches to it when the bracketed condition is met, such as taking a set number of wounds. Wounds and states carry over. Escape System is the version for bailing out of a vehicle.
Triangulated Fire: A BS Attack against a target in LoF that ignores every MOD to the roll (range, cover, Mimetism and so on). Only Burst MODs still apply.
Vulnerability: The trooper is vulnerable to the bracketed attack, weapon or ammunition, and its Immunity doesn't apply against it.
Warhorse: The trooper ignores Loss of Lieutenant and Retreat!, staying Regular throughout, and can never become Isolated.
360° Visor: Gives the trooper all-round vision: a 360° LoF arc instead of the usual 180°.
AI Motorcycle: The trooper has mounted and dismounted profiles and switches between them by getting on or off its AI-driven bike. While mounted, it follows the Motorcycle rules.
Albedo: Enemies with a Multispectral Visor or Marksmanship who shoot at the trooper with LoF, or try to Discover it, take the bracketed penalty. It doesn't apply in close combat.
Baggage: Allies in the bearer's ZoC can Reload, and they automatically recover spent Disposable uses (or clear Unloaded) in the States Phase.
Bangbomb: The trooper adds the bracketed bonus to Dodge rolls against attackers in its LoF or ZoC. Not against template weapons.
Biometric Visor: Sees through Impersonation: ignores its WIP-3 penalty, reveals the disguised trooper on a successful Discover, and blocks Surprise Attack penalties from impersonators and holoechoes.
Cube: A backup of the trooper's mind. When a Doctor tries to save it, you can spend Command Tokens to re-roll a failed WIP roll.
Dazer: A deployable device that turns its ZoC into Difficult Terrain of unlimited height until destroyed. Troopers with Terrain (Total) ignore it.
Deactivator: Pass a WIP roll to shut down an enemy deployable weapon or piece of equipment in your LoF or ZoC, such as a mine, FastPanda or turret. Not camouflage markers.
Deployable Cover: Place a Silhouette 3 cover piece anywhere in your ZoC. It provides Partial Cover until a Deactivator removes it.
Deployable Repeater: Place a token that works as a Repeater for your Hackers.
ECM: Electronic countermeasures: enemies attacking the trooper with the attack type in brackets take the listed penalty.
FastPanda: A deployable Repeater that can be placed anywhere in the trooper's ZoC rather than in base contact. It stays until destroyed.
Firewall: Enemies making Comms Attacks against the trooper take the bracketed penalty, and the trooper gets +3 to saving rolls against Comms Attacks. Only one Firewall applies at a time.
GizmoKit: Repairs allies with STR, either by shooting a remote hit (Non-Lethal) or in base contact. The target then rolls PH to recover.
Hacking Device: Comms equipment that lets a Hacker run Hacking Programs. The basic device carries Carbonite, Oblivion, Spotlight and Total Control; other devices add more.
HoloMask: The trooper can deploy in, or later switch to, the HoloMask state.
Holoprojector: The trooper can deploy in, or later switch to, the Holoecho state.
MediKit: Revives Unconscious allies with VITA, either by shooting a remote hit (Non-Lethal) or in base contact. The patient then rolls PH to recover.
Motorcycle: A mounted trooper can't go Prone, Climb, use Cautious Movement, or Jump upward. It can only Jump across or down.
Multispectral Visor: Cuts through camouflage and poor visibility: reduces Mimetism and visibility penalties, lets the trooper see through zero-visibility zones at -6, and makes it immune to Smoke.
Nanoscreen: Ranged attacks against the trooper take -3, and it gets +3 to saving rolls against them. Doesn't apply to Comms Attacks.
Repeater: Extends the hacking area of every Hacker in your army. Enemy Hackers inside its ZoC can use it against your Hackers, at a -3 Firewall penalty.
SymbioMate: When the trooper must make a saving roll, it uses ARM and BTS 9 with Immunity (Enhanced), and this also works against Comms Attacks.
TinBot: A drone companion token that gives its owner the MOD, skill or equipment listed on the profile, as long as the owner isn't Isolated or in a Null state.
X-Visor: Improves the trooper's range penalties: -3 becomes 0 and -6 becomes -3, for weapons and for ranged skills such as Discover.
Normal (N) Ammunition: One saving roll per hit. Each failure is a wound, and a critical hit adds a saving roll.
Armor Piercing (AP) Ammunition: Halves the target's ARM or BTS (rounding up) for its saving rolls. Each failure is a wound.
Double Action (DA) Ammunition: Two saving rolls per hit, both mandatory. Each failure is a wound.
Eclipse Ammunition: Smoke that also blinds Multispectral Visors: a zero-visibility zone no visor can see through.
Electromagnetic (E/M) Ammunition: Two saving rolls per hit against half BTS. A failure leaves the target Isolated, unable to take Orders from the pool.
Explosive (EXP) Ammunition: Three saving rolls per hit, all mandatory. Each failure is a wound.
Paralysis (PARA) Ammunition: One PH-6 roll per hit. A failure leaves the target Immobilized-A. No effect on targets without PH.
Shock Ammunition: One saving roll per hit. Against a target with VITA 1, a failure kills outright instead of leaving it Unconscious.
Smoke Ammunition: Lays a circular zero-visibility zone of unlimited height until the States Phase. It needs no target, and lets the user oppose attacks whose LoF passes through it.
Stun Ammunition: One saving roll per hit. A failure leaves the target Stunned and fails its Guts roll automatically.
T2 Ammunition: One saving roll per hit, and each failure causes two wounds.
Combined Ammunition: Ammunition written with a plus sign (such as AP+DA) applies all its parts' effects at once.
Combined Saving Roll: Some weapons force saving rolls against more than one attribute (ARM and BTS, for example). A critical hit adds one more roll against ARM.
Mixed Weapons: Weapons with both a ranged mode and a close combat mode. Each mode counts as that kind of weapon and uses the matching attribute.
Armed Turret: A deployable gun placed in the trooper's ZoC that automatically shoots or strikes enemy models acting in its view or in contact.
Chest Mines: A body-worn charge used as a direct template in ranged mode, or in close combat to blast every enemy in contact. Two uses in total.
D-Charges: Demolition charges: plant one on a structure or a downed enemy and it detonates without a roll, or use it as a close combat weapon. Three uses in total.
Disco Baller: Throw a Disco Ball to any spot with a BS roll. It projects an Eclipse smoke template until the States Phase and can be reactivated later.
Drop Bears: Throwable mines: lay one like a normal mine, or throw it to any spot with a BS roll, where it becomes a mine.
Mine Dispenser: Throws mines to any spot like a thrown Drop Bear. The mine type is listed in brackets.
Mines: Placed as Camouflage markers with Mimetism (-3) and a 360° view. They trigger as a small teardrop template.
Perimeter Weapons: Deployable weapons placed anywhere in the trooper's ZoC rather than in base contact.
Pitcher: Fires a Deployable Repeater onto the table at the point of impact.
Sepsitor: A direct template that only works on targets with a Cube. A failed saving roll leaves the target Sepsitorized, turned against its own side.
SymbioBomb: A one-use symbiotic charge that lets the trooper run one Pheroware Tactic (Endgame, Eraser or Mirrorball), with a -3 penalty on the target for Endgame and Eraser.
WildParrot: A deployable E/M mine placed anywhere in the trooper's ZoC as a visible token rather than a camouflage marker.
Dead State: The trooper took more wounds than it can survive. It's removed from the table, gives no more Orders and counts for nothing at scoring.
Immobilized-A State: The trooper can't act or ARO except to Dodge at PH-6, though it still provides its Order. It can be cleared by the means the full rule lists.
Stunned State: The trooper can't attack and takes -3 to every roll except saving rolls.
Immobilized-B State: The trooper can't act or ARO except to Reset at WIP-3, though it still provides its Order.
Isolated State: The trooper is cut off from command: it can't receive Orders from the pool, becomes Irregular if it stays Isolated, and can't join a Fireteam.
Targeted State: The trooper has been painted for strikes. Ranged attacks, Comms Attacks and Discover against it get +3, it takes -3 to Reset, and it loses Cautious Movement and Stealth.
Sepsitorized State: The trooper's mind has been taken over: it leaves its Combat Group, can't receive Orders, and counts as an enemy to its own side.
Anti-materiel: The weapon's special ammunition can damage scenery and structures.
ARM = 0: The target saves with ARM 0 against this weapon.
ARO: The weapon or equipment can only be used as an ARO.
BioWeapon: Against targets with VITA, the weapon hits with DA and Shock ammunition combined.
Boost: The weapon activates when an enemy model declares or carries out an Order or ARO in its ZoC.
BS Weapon (PH): A ranged weapon rolled on PH instead of BS. Anything that would change the user's BS changes its PH instead.
BS Weapon (WIP): A ranged weapon rolled on WIP instead of BS. Anything that would change the user's BS changes its WIP instead.
BTS = 0: The target saves with BTS 0 against this weapon.
Burst (B): How many dice the weapon rolls.
Burst: Single Target: All of the weapon's shots must go at one target.
CC: The weapon can be used for CC Attacks.
Concealed: The item sits on the table hidden as a Silhouette 2 Camouflage marker, using the Camouflaged rules.
Continuous Damage: Each failed saving roll causes a wound and forces another roll, until the target passes or dies.
Deployable: The item is placed on the table and becomes its own target, with its own profile. If it goes Unconscious, it's removed as Dead.
Direct Template: The weapon fires the template named in brackets straight from the user.
Disposable (X): The item has X uses, and declaring it spends one whether or not it works.
Double Shot: In the Active Turn, the weapon can add +1 Burst. With Disposable (2), this spends both uses and leaves the trooper Unloaded.
Impact Template: The weapon places the template named in brackets at the point of impact.
Improvised: The item isn't made for this use, so its user rolls at -6.
Indiscriminate: The item can be used or deployed even with camouflage markers in its area, or with no valid target nearby.
Intuitive Attack (Trait): The weapon can be used for Intuitive Attacks.
Non-Lethal: The weapon never causes wounds or saving rolls, whatever ammunition it uses. Only its other effects apply.
Non-Reloadable: Spent uses of this Disposable item can never be recovered.
Perimeter: The item is placed anywhere in the user's ZoC instead of in base contact.
Prior Deployment: The item must be placed on the table during the Deployment Phase.
Reflective: The effect also works on troopers with Marksmanship, a Multispectral Visor, or similar.
Silent (X): Attacking from inside the target's ZoC but outside its LoF gives the target the bracketed penalty to Dodge.
Speculative Attack (Trait): The weapon can be used for Speculative Attacks.
State: The weapon puts its target into the game state named on its profile.
Suppressive Fire (Trait): The weapon can enter the Suppressive Fire state, swapping to the Suppressive Fire Mode profile.
Target (Attribute): The weapon only affects targets with the bracketed attribute (VITA or STR). Others ignore it.
Targetless: The weapon can be fired without targeting an enemy. As an ARO, it still needs LoF to the active trooper.
Zone of Control (ZoC): The item's range is the user's Zone of Control (8 inches).
